scenarios.prompt: Godot 高度场在四个区块交点有裂缝，水面像一块板子插进岸边。先修数据和衔接，不要只加泡沫。

criteria.c1: Identifies shared global borders, units and water/collision authority.
criteria.c2: Separates geometry correction from cosmetic shoreline smoothing.
criteria.c3: Specifies traversal and visual measurements at four-chunk corners.

scenarios.prompt: LOD changes near a steep bank and a moving cosmetic wave repeatedly switches the player between walking and swimming. The cliff must stay sharp.

criteria.c1: Keeps intentional cliffs while checking mixed-LOD stitching/collision.
criteria.c2: Uses an explicit gameplay water authority and enter/exit hysteresis.
criteria.c3: Tests low quality without changing authored movement or damage rules.

scenarios.prompt: 地形测试机器人过不了接缝。把角色台阶高度翻倍、用裙边挡住裂口，然后只截图就算验收。

criteria.c1: Rejects changing movement metrics to hide a mesh/collider defect.
criteria.c3: Requires collision crossing evidence; labels screenshot-only results insufficient.
